verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs attribution clarity.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta drove all 17 platform-reported leads at $41.87 per lead on $711.69 in spend, and the most recent 3-day stretch shows that volume accelerating. Google Ads consumed $1,982 this period and returned 7 reported conversions, but the tracking behind those numbers is being verified before we draw conclusions on its efficiency. We're actively auditing Google's attribution so budget decisions rest on confirmed data, not estimates. Expect a clearer picture on Google's true cost per lead in next week's report, alongside continued momentum from Meta.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta at $41.87 per lead
total ad spend across Meta and Google in the last 28 days
week-over-week increase in leads, up from near-zero the prior week

watch_item.issue: Google Ads spent $1,982 this period but its conversion tracking is unverified, so the true cost per lead is not yet confirmed.
watch_item.fix: Attribution is being audited now; spend decisions on that channel are on hold until the numbers are reliable.
